entities.summary: Arseni Sergeyevich Gritsyuk is a Russian professional ice hockey player who is a winger for the New Jersey Devils of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected by the Devils 129th overall, in the fifth round of the 2019 NHL entry draft.
